Oh, how much his chest had ached, how empty and fearful he felt, seeing pain he could not temper, agony he could not control - but he had helped Phainon, as Phainon helped him, and they still needed more food, and to clean themselves properly, and work the tearing from their muscles with stretches, and sleep for another week or two, but in that moment none of these things matter at all.

What were they? He is sure that his mother and father never did this - hold each other, wake by each others side, speak of futures and togethers and equal ground. Were they simply mates, bonded in the knotting ceremony, married in the eyes of the kingdom and Lupa herself? No. Mydei thinks they must be more, now, than an Alpha Crown Prince and his chosen omega. More.

Whatever more meant.
